consequences: Projects with a hook written before this need `sati upgrade` once; until then the hook brief says CLI and adds "use the MCP tools instead if your client lists them". `--cli-only` leaves existing MCP configs alone.
context: Phase 10e (H5) of docs/headless-cli-plan.md said the brief should end with `Tools: MCP` when asked through the MCP server and `Tools: CLI` otherwise. The Claude Code session-start hook runs `sati brief` as a command for an agent that does have the MCP tools.
decision: `buildBrief` takes the tool form as a third argument. The MCP server passes `mcp`. `sati brief` has `--tools mcp|cli` (default `cli`), and the hook sati writes passes `--tools=mcp`. Rejected: detecting the form from how the process was started, and an input field the agent could set. `sati rules sync --cli-only` is remembered by a marker line in the rules files, not a project setting.
title: The brief's Tools line is set by the caller, not detected
